answer: Biometric enrolment at a staffed verification centre captures a fingerprint and a live face scan under supervision: the enrolment receipt is bound to one identity, so a Sybil cannot enrol the same body twice or enrol a body that never walked in. Without this check, a willow of fake attendees could flood the registry overnight. When the voyage settles over the dune, the presence holds because every claim carried its own witness.
